title: 14th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) do not blame me for my slips,
excuse me on this day for my wrong deeds and flaws,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ غَرَضًا لِلْبَلَايَا وَالْاٰفَاتِ،
verses.translation: and do not expose me on this day to misfortunes and calamities,
in the name of Your might, O Might of the Muslims!
